errors.evidence: The chart presents data for seven challenges, not just the top three.

errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос показва категориите на предизвикателствата
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis shows the numerical count of responses (0-20), while the vertical axis lists the categories of challenges.
The categories on the vertical axis are not sorted in alphabetical order.
The category name is incorrect. The chart shows "Роля и задължения на плани..." which translates to "Role and obligations of the planner...", not "Role of receivables of the plan...".

errors.text_span: Височината на всяка стълба представлява процента на участниците
errors.evidence: The chart is a horizontal bar chart, so it has length, not height. More importantly, the bar length corresponds to the absolute number of responses on the x-axis, not the percentage. Percentages are given only as text labels.
The bars reach a maximum value of 19 on the x-axis, which is an absolute count, not 19%. The percentage for that bar is 90.5%.
The description discusses only six of the seven categories, completely omitting the last category, "транспорт" (transport), which has a value of 1 (4.8%).
The value for the category "Очаквания на клиента/възло..." is 19%, not 4%. The number 4 is the absolute count of responses for that category, not the percentage.
The description fails to mention that the total number of responses is 105, which is explicitly stated in the figure's header.
The description fails to mention that in addition to percentages, the absolute number of responses for each category is also displayed as a label on the bars.
